content_sections.heading: About Hardoi Anganwadi Sahayika
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Programme Officer, Hardoi, who heads the Child Development (Bal Vikas) Department office of the district at Vikas Bhawan, Hardoi. The posts are in Anganwadi centres of the district's Child Development Projects, and the notice is signed by Manoj Kumar Rao, District Programme Officer, Hardoi. Copies are sent to the Director, Child Development Services and Nutrition, Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow, the District Magistrate, Hardoi, and the Chief Development Officer, Hardoi.

content_sections.heading: Hardoi Anganwadi Sahayika Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 4 November 2026, the online form has not opened yet; it opens on 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The notice lists the vacancies of 20 Child Development Projects, numbered 01 to 20, adding up to 315 posts. Projects 11 (47 posts) and 17 (46 posts) have the most vacancies. The notice says the number of vacancies may decrease or increase in special circumstances. The Child Development Project Officers will put the Gram Sabha-wise and reservation-wise list on the notice boards of the concerned Tehsil and block (Vikas Khand) offices and inform the Gram Pradhan or ward member of the vacant posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age: The applicant (आवेदिका) must be a minimum of 18 years and not more than 35 years on the cut-off date 01.07.2026. Proof of age: Only the date of birth printed in the High School marksheet and certificate is accepted. Income limit: Under Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 of Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2, Uttar Pradesh, the annual income limit is Rs. 46,080.00 in rural areas and Rs. 56,460.00 in urban areas. Income certificate: It must be issued online with a digital signature by the Tehsil so that it can be verified online. Only certificates issued by the competent level under Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Rajasva-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended) of Revenue Section-9, Uttar Pradesh, that can be verified online are valid. Residence and caste certificates: Only certificates issued online with a digital signature by the Tehsil, which can be verified online, are valid. The notice does not state the educational qualification in the pages that could be read; it says the detailed format with the qualification and application process is on http://upanganwadibharti.in , so check the post-wise eligibility there and in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to the Anganwadi Sahayika/Karyakatri posts follows this order of preference, always among candidates of the same Gram Sabha or ward (in urban areas): Widow BPL candidate. Divorced or abandoned (Talakshuda/Parityakta) BPL candidate. BPL candidate. Widow APL candidate. Divorced or abandoned APL candidate. APL candidate on the basis of merit. For a widow, only a certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned urban local body, with an attested copy of the family register (Parivar Register), is valid. For a divorced or abandoned woman, only a legal or court order is valid.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hardoi Anganwadi Sahayika
content_sections.text: Apply only online on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in . Submit the form between 6 November 2026 and 26 November 2026, up to 12:00 midnight; forms are accepted only within this period. Do not send an offline form; offline application forms will not be accepted in any case. For more information, contact the Child Development Project Office of the block or the District Programme Officer (Child Development Department) office at Vikas Bhawan on any working day during office hours. faq.question: Q1. How many Anganwadi Sahayika vacancies are there in Hardoi in 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 315 Anganwadi Sahayika posts across 20 Child Development Projects of Hardoi district; the number may decrease or increase in special circumstances.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Hardoi Anganwadi online form?
faq.answer: Online applications are accepted from 6 November 2026 to 26 November 2026, up to 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Hardoi Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: The applicant must be a minimum of 18 years and not more than 35 years as on the cut-off date 01.07.2026, by the date of birth in the High School marksheet and certificate.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only on http://upanganwadibharti.in within the application period; offline forms will not be accepted in any case.

faq.question: Q5. How are Anganwadi Sahayika candidates selected in Hardoi?
faq.answer: Preference within the same Gram Sabha or ward goes, in order, to widow BPL, divorced or abandoned BPL, BPL, widow APL, divorced or abandoned APL, and then APL candidates on merit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the income limit for Hardoi Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: The annual income limit is Rs. 46,080.00 in rural areas and Rs. 56,460.00 in urban areas, under the Government Order dated 14 September 2015.

faq.question: Q7. Which income, caste and residence certificates are valid?
faq.answer: Only certificates issued online with a digital signature by the Tehsil that can be verified online are valid.

faq.question: Q8. What proof is needed for widow or divorced status?
faq.answer: Widows need a certificate from the Gram Panchayat Officer or the urban body with an attested copy of the family register; divorced or abandoned women need a legal or court order.

faq.question: Q9. Can I correct an error in my form offline?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no offline application for error correction will be considered, and wrong or forged details lead to cancellation of candidature.
